text:
Today, my mother and I go to the shop to buy new clothes. I need a shirt, trousers, and shoes for school. My old shoes are too small now.

At the shop, I see many colors. I like blue and green, but my mother likes red and yellow. I choose a blue shirt and black trousers. My mother buys a white dress for herself. We also look at hats and jackets because winter is coming soon.

I want new shoes too. I try on black shoes and white shoes. I choose the black ones because they look nice with my clothes. My mother buys me new socks as well.

At home, I wear my new clothes. My little sister wears her green skirt and a yellow hat. She looks very happy. My old clothes are too small, so we give them to a friend.

I like my new clothes very much. Next time, I want to buy a warm jacket in a different color, maybe black or blue.
